method.stopper: last shipment <= 2034-06 (silent for the final 6+ months), >= 10 shipments in >= 3 months
method.starter: first shipment >= 2028-07, >= 5 shipments in >= 2 months, starts and ends later than the predecessor
method.window: successor's first month is -6..+12 months from the predecessor's last month
method.similarity: partner and HS profiles are log-count TF-IDF vectors (a shared hub or ubiquitous HS code counts little); Jaccard overlaps of the raw sets are also used
method.filters: >= 2 shared partners; score >= 0.45; best successor of the stopper or best predecessor of the starter

verdicts.Suspect: strong (score >= 0.70, >= 3 shared partners, HS cosine >= 0.6, gap -3..+6, >= 50% of shared partners switch over) AND mutual best match AND both sides trade fish (>= 30%)
verdicts.Possible: strong but not fish/mutual, or score >= 0.60 with partner switch-over and fish trade
verdicts.Insufficient evidence: a candidate that meets the filters but not the bars above
verdicts.Unlikely: predecessor keeps trading in reliable predicted links, or shared partners did not switch over (< 25%), or a weak non-mutual match (score < 0.55)

confidence.High: >= 5 shared partners, predecessor >= 30 and successor >= 15 shipments (or >= 3 reliable predicted links contradicting the stop)

shipper.criteria: partner cosine >= 0.7, HS cosine >= 0.7, >= 3 shared partners, both companies >= 10 shipments in >= 3 months, later company starts and ends after the earlier one

receiver.criteria: partner cosine >= 0.7, HS cosine >= 0.7, >= 3 shared partners, both companies >= 10 shipments in >= 3 months, later company starts and ends after the earlier one
